paragraphs: Fintech must deliver instant credit decisions while keeping risk low – I tackled this by creating an agentic tool that can pull data, analyse it and act autonomously, all in a single Python stack.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, delivering a system that retrieves and synthesises information on demand.
